risk_if_not_implemented: Without Cross-Organizational Monitoring, malicious, anomalous or unauthorized activity may go undetected or be detected too late to prevent or limit harm. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Undetected / Delayed Detection of Adverse Activity (R-SA-1), Loss of Confidentiality (R-IP-2), and most likely increases susceptibility to Statutory / Regulatory / Contractual Change (MT-11).

compensating_control_1.name: Interconnection Security Agreements (ISAs)
compensating_control_1.justification: Interconnection Security Agreements (ISAs) (NET-05) provides overlapping security capability that compensates for the absence of Cross-Organizational Monitoring (MON-36.1) by addressing related risk objectives through an alternative control mechanism aligned with Technology applicability. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Third-Party Management
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to facilitate the implementation of third-party management controls.
compensating_control_2.justification: Third-Party Management (TPM-02) provides third-party oversight that compensates for the absence of Cross-Organizational Monitoring (MON-36.1) by extending security obligations contractually and monitoring third-party risk in lieu of direct control. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
